item.title: Waltz shuts down NBC anchor, arguing Trump is ending a war Iran started with the US in 1979
item.summary: UN Ambassador Mike Waltz told NBC's Kristen Welker that President Trump is ending a war with Iran that began in 1979, not starting a new conflict.

item.title: Before-and-after satellite imagery offers a rare look at damage inside Iran
item.summary: Satellite images reveal extensive damage across Iran following the U.S.-Israeli strikes, showing burning facilities and destruction from Tehran to the Gulf.

item.title: Deion Sanders delivers heartbreaking eulogy for Colorado player who died tragically at 23
item.summary: Deion Sanders delivered a heartfelt eulogy for Colorado quarterback Dominiq Ponder, saying the late 23-year-old 'was chosen' to unite people in his powerful message.

item.title: Bengals star Ja'Marr Chase delivers expletive-filled reaction to Ravens trading for Maxx Crosby: 'Oh my God!'
item.summary: Bengals star Ja'Marr Chase unleashed an expletive-filled rant on a livestream after learning the Ravens traded for Raiders pass rusher Maxx Crosby.

item.title: US-sanctioned Mojtaba Khamenei named Iran’s next supreme leader after father’s death: reports
item.summary: Mojtaba Khamenei, son of Iran's current late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was reportedly chosen as the next supreme leader under pressure from the IRGC.

item.title: Trump admin turns Venezuela into major US oil supplier as global shipping crisis eases
item.summary: Major policy shift sees Venezuela become key U.S. oil supplier under Trump administration, with new contracts signed for Gulf Coast refineries.

item.title: 'Ghostbusters' actress Jennifer Runyon dead at 65
item.summary: Actress Jennifer Runyon Corman, who starred in '80s classics such as "Ghostbusters" and "Charles in Charge," died Friday following a cancer battle. She was 65.

item.title: 'Country Joe' McDonald dead at 84
item.summary: Joseph McDonald, a.k.a. "Country Joe" of Country Joe and the Fish, died in Berkeley, Calif. on Saturday following complications with Parkinson's disease.

item.title: Jesse Jackson Jr. rebukes Obama, Clinton and Biden for not truly knowing his father during memorial service
item.summary: Jesse Jackson Jr. rips former presidents Biden, Obama and Clinton at his father's funeral saying "They do not know Jesse Jackson."

item.title: Rihanna's Beverly Hills home targeted in brazen daylight shooting
item.summary: Rihanna was reportedly home when a female suspect fired "approximately 10 shots" at her Beverly Hills mansion on Sunday, according to LAPD officials.
